<subject>Electronic Transactions Agreement - revised</subject>
<body>
As you know, the ETA has to address NexTel one-to-many with Maple & Crown and TelcoNet one-to-many with Maple & Crown. We also need a separate NexTel GTC one-to-many with Maple & Crown and separate TelcoNet GTC one-to-many with Maple & Crown. We also need a single GlobeCom application that addresses CableLink, both one-to-many.

As soon as these drafts are complete, I would like to review them!

Thanks.

GP
</body>
<quoted>
---------------------- Forwarded by Lee Mills on 7/10/2024 11:33 AM ---------------------------
From: Marcus Finley@maplecrown.ca on 7/9/2024 08:33 PM
To: Lee Mills, Nicholas Porter, John Cummings, Bradley Miller, Douglas Dixon, Harry M Collins, Sandra Wood
cc:  
Subject: Electronic Transactions Agreement - revised

Attached is a revised version of the ETA omitting the distinction between transactions on TelcoNet and transactions on NexTel. If Maple & Crown is the only party permitted to post network services on TelcoNet, there is no need for the special rules that we drafted for what was previously a "many-to-many" matching platform. However, we will need to develop a different set of GTCs for transactions that Maple & Crown closes on TelcoNet, since the services transacted on TelcoNet are not likely to be the type that conform to Maple & Crown’s standard GTCs.
